plan.notes: Source: official LSU General Catalog page 'Computer Science, B.S.' (catalog.lsu.edu/preview_program.php?catoid=29&poid=12770), labeled '2024-2025 General Catalog [ARCHIVED CATALOG]'. LSU's CS BS is offered with five concentrations (Cloud Computing and Networking; Computer Science and Second Discipline; Cybersecurity; Data Science and Analytics; Software Engineering). Transcribed term-by-term is the 'Computer Science and Second Discipline' (SD) concentration sequence -- the general CS track -- verbatim from the catalog's Semester 1-8 plan, totaling 120 semester hours. Program/degree name 'Computer Science, B.S.' verified verbatim against the catalog page; the School of Electrical Engineering & Computer Science (College of Engineering) lists 'Computer Science, BS' as its degree offering. The official LSU College of Engineering 2026-2027 SD flowchart (lsu.edu/eng/docs/Flowcharts/2026-2027/csc-sd_flowchart_2026-2027.pdf) corroborates the same eight-semester progression. Transcription method: fetched the official catalog page with a text-reading tool on 2026-09-30 and transcribed course codes, titles, and credit hours verbatim; no courses, credits, or prerequisites were invented. Caveats: (1) All 'choice' slots are student-chosen per catalog footnotes -- exact course selections vary per student. (2) The catalog's CRITICAL markers (MATH 1021 in Semester 1; 'C' or better in ENGL 1001, MATH 1550/MATH 1551, CSC 2259; completion of MATH 2090) are progression/milestone requirements, not courses, and are not listed as course slots. MATH 1021 (College Algebra placement-level math) is listed in external_prereqs as entry-level math background expected before MATH 1550; credit for pre-calculus math cannot apply to the degree. (3) The semester plan page does not state per-course prerequisites, so all prereq arrays are empty rather than invented. (4) Catalog-approved substitutions: EE 3740 may substitute for CSC 2259 (not both); EE 3755 for CSC 3501 (not both); MATH 3355 or EE 3150 or EXST 4050 for IE 3302. (5) CS students receive no degree credit for CSC 1240, ELRC 4006, EXST 2201, ISDS 2000/2001/2010/2011/3070/3075, PSYC 4111, SOCL 2201. (6) Semester 3 sums to 17 and Semester 5 sums to 15 per the catalog's course listings; printed catalog totals shown for Semesters 1, 2, 4, 6, 7, 8 match the transcribed sums.

courses.title: General Education: Natural Sciences (first science course)
courses.choice_note: GenEd natural-science requirement (footnote 1): one 3-cr Life Science course (BIOL 1001 or BIOL 1201); one 3-cr Physical Science course (PHYS 1201, PHYS 2001, CHEM 1001, CHEM 1201, CHEM 1421, ASTR 1101, GEOL 1001, or GEOL 1003); a second 3-cr course to complete the sequence in either the BIOL or the physical science; plus 2 cr of science lab wholly associated with the chosen sequence.

courses.choice_note: Approved Technical Elective (footnote 3): 3 hrs from Group A plus 3 hrs from Group A or Group B. courses.choice_note: Approved SD Area Elective (footnote 2): an approved second-discipline concentration of 15 semester hours in ONE area outside the Dept. of Computer Science (or a multidisciplined minor); all courses normally from a single department, forming a coherent sequence; ordinarily at least two courses numbered 3000 or above; ISDS courses must be 3100 or above; approval form due no later than sophomore year.
